# sshverify

```go
import "github.com/danmestas/go-libfossil/sshverify"
```

Package sshverify links in\-process verification of SSH signatures into a program that uses go\-libfossil. Import it for its side effect:

```
import _ "github.com/danmestas/go-libfossil/sshverify"
```

Without it, the library links no SSH cryptography, and a signature it would have to check against an SSH public key, such as a structural horizon seed under an SSH libfossil.SettingHorizonSeedKey, is refused with libfossil.ErrSSHVerifierUnavailable. Signing needs no import: it runs ssh\-keygen. PGP signatures are verified by gpg either way.
